blocks.text: Before the sun is up, Filipinos are already on the move. Runners fill the streets of BGC, cyclists climb the roads of Rizal, and hikers set off for trails from the Cordilleras to Mindanao. More and more of them do it with a smartwatch on their wrist, and VST ECS Phils., Inc. wants to make sure it’s one built for the way they move. VST ECS, one of the country’s leading ICT distributors, has officially partnered with Garmin, the global brand known for purpose-built wearables for fitness, the outdoors and everyday wellness.
